title: SAGORAX ARENA — The Arena Is Back
excerpt: Classic Weapons Deathmatch and lethal Instagib in one fast, free browser arena shooter. Pick your loadout and enter the arena.
content_html:
CLASSIC ARENA COMBAT. REBUILT.

THE ARENA
IS BACK.

The instant rush of the UT99 and UT2k4 era, reborn as SAGORAX. Enter Classic Weapons Deathmatch with a balanced four-gun loadout, or strip it back to pure one-hit Instagib. No loadout grind. No battle-pass homework. Just pick a mode and start firing.

TWO MODESFOUR WEAPONSKBM + GAMEPAD

SCROLL TO ENTER

01 / WHY I BUILT IT

I LOVED
INSTAGIB.

“I loved Unreal Tournament. I loved Instagib.”

This game is a tribute to that original feeling when arena shooters were in their prime: extremely fast, slightly chaotic, but somehow everything felt right. Movement, jumps and strafes clicked instantly.

It was easy to start and brutally hard to master. SAGORAX is my attempt to capture that feeling again—not as a museum piece, but as a new game with modern light, speed and weight.

— THE ORIGIN OF SAGORAX

NO CLASSES

NO LOOT TIERS

NO WAITING

JUST AIM. MOVE. FIRE.

OFFICIAL TRANSMISSION / GAMEPLAY TRAILER

SEE THE ARENA
IN MOTION.

Weapons Deathmatch, pure Instagib and adrenaline-fuelled chaos. This is SAGORAX running live in the browser, captured in 4K.

02 / CLASSIC WEAPONS DEATHMATCH

FOUR WEAPONS.
NO DEAD SLOTS.

Every gun owns a purpose, a range and a counter. Choose the order of your 1—4 loadout, collect ammo in the arena and switch before the next fight switches you off.

WEAPON 01

PLASMA RIFLE

A fast precision beam for dependable pressure. Alternate fire launches a plasma orb; hit your own orb with the primary beam to detonate a devastating combo.

PRIMARY
PRECISION BEAM

ALT FIRE
COMBO ORB

03 / BATTLEGROUNDS

FOUR ARENAS.
NO SAFE GROUND.

Every arena has its own rhythm: hunt through rain-soaked gardens, disappear into torch-lit corridors, fight for a steel station or storm the battlements of a gothic castle.

DM / 01

AUTUMN

Storm-lit gardens, wet stone and long-range pressure.

DM / 02

COURSE

A torch-lit gothic fort with a flooded heart.

DM / 03

STATION

Industrial verticality, launch pads and hard steel.

DM / 04

CASTLE

Rain-swept battlements above a purple storm.

ARENA RULE 01

“READ THE ROOM.
MOVE BEFORE THEY AIM.”

SPEED IS YOUR ARMOUR

COMBAT SYSTEM / ADRENALINE

PLAY BETTER.
GET WILDER.

Frags, Double Kills and killing sprees charge your Adrenaline. Spend it early to change the next fight, or hold your nerve and unlock the most destructive power in the arena.

PRESS 7—0 TO ACTIVATEUSING ANY POWER EMPTIES THE ENTIRE BAR

25% / KEY 7

SPEED

Move at twice the pace. The world stretches, the music hits harder and the arena becomes pure chaos.

50% / KEY 8

INVINCIBILITY

Walk through enemy fire untouched for a short, precious window.

75% / KEY 9

EXTRA JUMP

Break gravity with higher jumps, more air and one extra leap above the fight.

100% / KEY 0

NUKE YOURSELF

Arm your own reactor and take the room with you. Classic Deathmatch gets the nuke; Instagib turns its final tier into lethal Spray Mode.

04 / ARENA AUDIO LINKSTANDBY

0:00 3:10

LIVE FROM THE MAIN MENU

04 / SOUND OF THE ARENA

BUILT TO GET
YOU MOVING.

Breakbeats, distorted synths and late-90s electronic pressure. The soundtrack is not background decoration—it pushes the countdown, sharpens the next dodge and makes “one more match” feel inevitable.

  • RETRO-FUTURE ELECTRONICS
  • ADAPTIVE COMBAT ENERGY
  • CLASSIC ARENA ATTITUDE

05 / UNDER THE ARMOUR

BUILT FOR
THE FIGHT.
NOT THE BENCHMARK.

SAGORAX is a game first. Underneath, it is built entirely with Three.js and WebGPU, with every technical choice serving clear aim, fast movement and atmosphere.

01

THREE.JS + WEBGPU

A modern browser renderer powering the whole arena, from the first menu frame to the last frag.

02

SMART PERFORMANCE

FSR 3, adaptive resolution and careful level optimisation protect fluid play without flattening the world.

03

WEATHER WITH WEIGHT

Rain hits wet stone, torchlight moves over old walls and reflections turn every arena into a place with a mood.

04

MOVEMENT COMES FIRST

Every visual system yields to the thing that matters most: immediate aim, sharp dodges and momentum you can feel.

06 / LIVE TELEMETRY

THE ARENA
REMEMBERS.

Every completed, server-verified trial match contributes to the public record. Account history and settings follow your gamertag from the first frag onward.

—PLAYERS

—MATCHES

—FRAGS

—HOURS PLAYED

07 / BEFORE YOU SPAWN

STRAIGHT
ANSWERS.

No launcher, no enormous install and no maze of unlocks. This public trial is built to get you from the homepage to your first frag as quickly as the browser allows.

WHAT IS SAGORAX ARENA?

A free browser-based arena FPS inspired by the speed and movement feel of classic UT99 and UT2k4 combat. Classic Weapons Deathmatch is the default; dedicated Instagib remains one click away.

IS THE WEAPON LOADOUT BALANCED?

Yes. Plasma, Shotgun, Flak and Rockets are tuned as one competitive set: each dominates a different range, alternate fire changes its tactical role and arena ammo prevents mindless spam.

WHAT DO I NEED TO PLAY?

A desktop or laptop and a modern WebGPU-compatible browser. Play with keyboard and mouse or connect an Xbox/PlayStation-style gamepad; SAGORAX detects the controller layout automatically. Unchanged assets stay cached, so returning is much faster.

IS THIS MULTIPLAYER?

The current public trial is a single-player deathmatch against bots with persistent accounts, match history and leaderboards. Full multiplayer is planned for a later phase.

WHO IS BUILDING THIS?

SAGORAX is an independent passion project, shaped by years of loving Instagib and the particular movement, music and atmosphere that made classic arena shooters unforgettable.

08 / SHAPE THE NEXT BUILD

YOUR CALL.
WHAT COMES NEXT?

Instagib or Classic Deathmatch? More weapons, more arenas or multiplayer first? Four quick choices help decide where SAGORAX goes next.

YOUR NEXT MATCH IS WAITING

STOP READING.
START FIRING.

经典竞技场战斗。 重建。

阿里纳斯回来了。

UT99和UT2k4时代的瞬间冲锋，重生为SAGORAX。 使用平衡的四枪装备进入经典武器死亡竞赛，或者将其剥离回纯粹的一击 Instagib。 无装载研磨。 没有战斗通行证作业。 只需选择一种模式并开始射击。

两种模式四种武器SKBM + 游戏手柄

SCROLL TO ENTER

01 / 为什么我建造它

我喜欢 DINSTAGIB。

“我喜欢《虚幻竞技场》。 我喜欢 Instagib。”

这款游戏是对竞技场射击游戏巅峰时期的原始感觉的致敬：速度极快，有点混乱，但不知怎的，一切都感觉不错。 移动、跳跃和扫射瞬间完成。

它很容易上手，但很难掌握。 SAGORAX 是我再次捕捉这种感觉的尝试——不是作为博物馆藏品，而是作为一款具有现代光线、速度和重量的新游戏。

— SAGORAX 的起源

没有课程

没有战利品等级

无需等待

JUST AIM. MOVE. FIRE.

官方传播/游戏预告片

查看竞技场动议。

武器死亡竞赛、纯粹的 Instagib 和刺激的混乱。 这是在浏览器中实时运行的 SAGORAX，以 4K 格式捕获。

02 / 经典武器死斗

四种武器，无死角。

每把枪都有自己的用途、射程和计数器。 选择 1-4 装备的顺序，在竞技场中收集弹药并在下一场战斗让你失望之前切换。

WEAPON 01

等离子步枪

快速精密横梁，可提供可靠的压力。 交替射击发射等离子球；用主光束击中你自己的球体，引爆毁灭性的连击。

初级精密光束

替代火焰组合球

03 / 战场

四个竞技场，没有安全之地。

每个竞技场都有自己的节奏：在被雨水浸湿的花园中狩猎，消失在火把照亮的走廊里，为钢铁站而战，或者冲进哥特式城堡的城垛。

DM / 01

秋天

暴风雨照耀的花园、潮湿的石头和远程压力。

DM / 02

课程

一座火炬点燃的哥特式堡垒，一颗被淹没的心。

DM / 03

车站

工业垂直度、发射台和硬钢。

DM / 04

城堡

紫色风暴上方被雨水冲刷的城垛。

竞技场规则 01

“了解房间。在他们瞄准之前先行动。”

速度是你的盔甲

战斗系统/肾上腺素

玩得更好，变得更狂野。

杀戮、双杀和疯狂杀戮会激发你的肾上腺素。 尽早花掉它来改变下一场战斗，或者保持镇定并释放竞技场中最具破坏性的力量。

按 7-0 激活使用任何能量会清空整个条

25% / KEY 7

SPEED

以两倍的速度移动。 世界在延伸，音乐更加震撼，竞技场变得一片混乱。

50% / KEY 8

无敌

毫发无伤地穿过敌人的火力，获得短暂而宝贵的机会。

75% / KEY 9

额外跳跃

通过更高的跳跃、更多的空气和一次额外的跳跃来打破重力。

100% / KEY 0

用核武器攻击自己

武装你自己的反应堆并随身携带房间。 经典死亡竞赛获得核武器； Instagib 将其最后一层转变为致命的喷雾模式。

04 / 竞技场之声

专为让您移动而打造。

碎拍、扭曲的合成器和 90 年代末的电子压力。 配乐不是背景装饰——它推动了倒计时，提高了下一次躲避的速度，让“再来一场”感觉不可避免。

  • 复古未来电子产品
  • 自适应战斗能量
  • 经典的竞技场态度

05 / 铠甲之下

为战斗而生，而非基准。

SAGORAX 首先是一款游戏。 在底层，它完全使用 Three.js 和 WebGPU 构建，每项技术选择都服务于明确的目标、快速的移动和氛围。

01

三.JS+WEBGPU

现代浏览器渲染器为整个舞台提供动力，从第一个菜单框架到最后一个片段。

02

智能性能

FSR 3、自适应分辨率和仔细的关卡优化可确保流畅的游戏体验，而不会导致世界变平。

03

天气与重量

雨水打在湿漉漉的石头上，火炬的光芒在古老的墙壁上移动，倒影将每个竞技场变成一个充满情绪的地方。

04

运动第一

每个视觉系统都会屈服于最重要的事情：直接瞄准、敏锐的闪避和你能感觉到的动力。

06 / 实时遥测

竞技场成员。

每一场完成的、经过服务器验证的试赛都会对公共记录做出贡献。 从第一个碎片开始，帐户历史记录和设置就遵循您的玩家代号。

07 / 在你产卵之前

直接回答。

没有启动器，没有巨大的安装，也没有迷宫般的解锁。 此公开试用版旨在让您在浏览器允许的情况下尽快从主页到达第一个片段。

WHAT IS SAGORAX ARENA?

一款基于浏览器的免费竞技场 FPS，灵感源自经典 UT99 和 UT2k4 战斗的速度和运动感。 默认为经典武器死亡竞赛；只需点击一下即可获得专用的 Instagib。

IS THE WEAPON LOADOUT BALANCED?

是的。 等离子、霰弹枪、高射炮和火箭被调整为一组竞争性武器：每一种都主宰不同的范围，交替射击改变其战术角色，竞技场弹药可以防止无意识的垃圾邮件。

WHAT DO I NEED TO PLAY?

台式机或笔记本电脑以及现代 WebGPU 兼容的浏览器。 使用键盘和鼠标进行游戏或连接 Xbox/PlayStation 式游戏手柄； SAGORAX 自动检测控制器布局。 未更改的资源会被缓存，因此返回速度要快得多。

IS THIS MULTIPLAYER?

当前的公开试验是一场单人死亡竞赛，对阵具有持久账户、比赛历史和排行榜的机器人。 完整的多人游戏计划在稍后阶段进行。

WHO IS BUILDING THIS?

SAGORAX 是一个独立的激情项目，由多年来对 Instagib 的喜爱以及让经典竞技场射击游戏令人难忘的独特动作、音乐和氛围塑造而成。
